name: EKS-to-RDS Communication Path
documentation: The logical communication path between the AWS EKS payment cluster (aws-eks-payment-cluster) and the AWS RDS PostgreSQL database node (aws-rds-postgres-db). Application workloads running inside the EKS cluster connect to the PostgreSQL database over this path to perform CRUD operations against the payment_db. The path is inferred from the co-existence of both resources within the same AWS account (123456789012) and the typical microservices-to-database connectivity pattern. The actual transport is TCP/IP over the AWS internal VPC network; security group rules and IAM policies (not captured in this Terraform file) govern access control along this path.
